answer_summary:
Synapse offers an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that enables AI assistants to interact directly with Synapse's services, allowing for tasks such as searching datasets, inspecting entity metadata, exploring project hierarchies, and tracing provenance. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))

To integrate with Synapse's MCP server, you can use the following URL: `https://mcp.synapse.org/mcp`. Authentication is managed via OAuth2, eliminating the need for manual token management. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))

For example, to add Synapse's MCP server to Claude Code (CLI), you can use the command:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http synapse -- https://mcp.synapse.org/mcp
```

This command will prompt you to complete the OAuth2 login process through a browser window. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))
